description: Find places near a Canadian postal code where a parcel can be dropped off or picked up. No account needed. Covers Canada Post outlets, FedEx locations, UniUni drop-off points and MesColis counters, nearest first, with the address, distance, what can be done there and a map link. Optionally limit the search to one network. Opening hours vary, so suggest checking the map link before going.

lang.description: Language of the answer. Defaults to the user's locale, then to the site's language.

network.description: Limit to one network: canada_post, fedex, uniuni or mescolis. Defaults to "any".

postal_code.description: A full Canadian postal code, e.g. "H2X 1Y1".

name: find_drop_off_points
title: Find drop-off and pick-up points
